transitiveDelayDiagnosis.interpretation: Component closure creates score-time holds independent of ORT duration. Local-publication comparison removes neural and capture latency from the avoidable hold estimate. No causal claim of GPU/thermal drift.

mathematicalHorizon.strike: For strike t only observations in [t-w,t+w] are legal. Frontier >=t+w covers all such evidence. Commit closed strikes first; do not reserve for open strikes.
mathematicalHorizon.group: Group g spans [a,b]. Required frontier b+w. At that frontier assign residual incompatible observations in [a-w,a+w] among simultaneously closed groups. Wrong may preempt an open future strike; intentional bounded-policy tradeoff, measured against original whole-component policy.
mathematicalHorizon.extra: For observation s, directly eligible strike t satisfies t<=s+w, closes <=s+2w. Wrong claimant group min a<=s+w, max b<=a+Delta, closes <=s+2w+Delta. Wait only max deadline of direct claimants, not their transitive neighbors. Delta is the actual frozen group span (physical grouping <=20ms here).
mathematicalHorizon.terminal: Natural completion may clamp required frontier to declared scope end; manual completion marks not-yet-closed strikes NOT_REACHED.
mathematicalHorizon.witnessAudit: Group required frontier = local deadline (or explicit terminal clamp); extra required frontier = maximum directly eligible local deadline. No dependency on transitive components.

tolerance.rationale: Float32 FIR summation over at most56 contributing taps; tolerance covers accumulation order, not time shifting or gain fitting. Fixtures bounded to [-1,1]. Frozen before first parity comparison.

browserBandLimited.timingCoordinateIdentity: output sample m represents source m*441/160; zero-phase compensation requires up to 28 real source samples of lookahead, 0.6349206349ms; no shift fitted to audio or predictions.
browserBandLimited.limits: Pinned FIR/rational-rate PCM path only; no AudioWorklet/device capture or UI qualification.

knownEvidenceLimitations: Replay uses already-seen XC2 DEVELOPMENT/EVALUATION; diagnostic only, no fresh winner.
Bounded closed-WRONG priority can preempt observations from open future expected matches. Substantial missing/incomplete detection tradeoff; not a production-ledger migration.
Conditional correct-class latency percentiles have changing denominators; paired fixed-target distributions separately retained.
Three28-second clips, three sessions/config; no indefinite-runtime, device capture, AudioWorklet, UI/render/perceptual or thermal-cause proof.
No contemporaneous original/new harness A/B; pure ORT variation is not explained by persistence removal.
Configuration positions globally balanced, but order within a particular clip is not independently randomized.
Ten of1269 browser timers fired sub-millisecond early (minimum -0.434726ms); raw source-time scheduling rows retained, no hard sample-clock causal deadline claim.
Streaming FIR reference/chunk parity covers frozen fixtures and three real guarded PCM clips; not arbitrary hardware capture-clock drift qualification.
LINEAR runtime assumes pre-existing canonical16k PCM; no new browser-linear stereo microphone front-end qualification.
Historical same-pitch and all-group component counts are scenario-expanded, not independent statistical replicates.
XC2 expected score times derived from physical MIDI, so no natural early/late timing external validity.
Empty GitHub status/workflow arrays are not CI PASS.
